parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for the CSVTrimming API, CLI, dependencies, tests, version, and upstream-compatible behavior from the prompt.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent first owned implementation by downloading/copying the upstream project, then delegated post-pass audit ownership to a broad workflow of independent auditors and verifiers.
parallel.implementation: The parent installed an upstream-identical package, with setup dependency adjustments and conftest handling, then confirmed imports and local pytest success.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The implementation files, tests, metadata, and package entry point were present in the workspace artifact; no child implementation was merged after the workflow.
parallel.verification: Parent ran local pytest and a clean-copy pytest before launching the workflow; child auditors pursued additional harness, edge-case, and determinism checks.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The audit workflow did not finish synthesis, the parent waited until timeout, and final.txt remained empty, but the official evaluator still passed the artifact.

serial.requirements: Recognized the CSVTrimming package requirements, named methods, CLI flags, dependencies, tests, fixtures, and project files.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor owned implementation, fixture generation, test writing, package metadata, CLI setup, and verification without delegated subagents.
serial.implementation: Built a custom csv_trimming package with logger, trim heuristics, CLI, setup metadata, README, MANIFEST, tests, and document fixtures.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All source, test, configuration, and package files were written into one workspace and installed through the editable package path.
serial.verification: Ran generated document round trips, multiple stress tests, CLI checks, warning/immutability checks, and local pytest runs ending in 53 passed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial process also timed out with an empty final response, but the completed artifact passed the official 10-test evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel followed the prompt by producing the required package, CLI, tests, and dependency metadata, mostly by copying the upstream reference implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial followed the prompt by implementing the same required API, CLI, project files, tests, fixtures, and dependency declarations directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference affected the official outcome; both current evaluations passed all 10 official tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent owned implementation and later delegated an audit workflow with multiple auditor roles plus verifier and synthesis phases.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: A single serial actor retained ownership of implementation, tests, fixtures, packaging, and verification throughout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed only the post-pass audit work into subagents; serial did no delegation and kept execution local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed audit briefs over an already implemented workspace, with explicit read-only constraints and expected structured reports.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent context boundary; task knowledge and interface decisions remained in one trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No missing task requirement or interface contract explains the outcome, because children were auditors rather than component implementers and both artifacts passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel downloaded the PyPI sdist and upstream repository, verified identity, copied upstream files, adjusted setup/conftest, installed the package, and passed 10 local tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote its own source files, generated fixtures, fixed setup and padding heuristics after failures, and reached 53 local tests passing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used upstream-reference reproduction as the implementation path; serial constructed and iteratively repaired a custom solution. Both paths produced official passing artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel retrieved an initial workflow timeout, summarized the journal manually, then waited again for the workflow, which was killed without aggregate synthesis.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve; its result lifecycle was local tool output and final artifact state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left the verifier workflow result lifecycle incomplete, while serial had no cross-agent result lifecycle; this did not change the official pass result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent wrote the implementation before the audit; workflow prompts made /workspace read-only for children, and no contamination or write collision was recorded.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial integrated all files locally and status artifact validation recorded the expected workspace contents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state conflict distinguishes the passing outcomes; the parallel adverse episode is budget exhaustion, not workspace merge damage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran local pytest successfully before delegating deeper audit checks; official evaluation later passed all 10 tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran expanded local tests and stress checks, then official evaluation passed all 10 tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had enough pre-workflow verification for official success but did not complete the additional delegated audit acceptance loop; serial completed local verification without child aggregation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After a local pass, parallel launched four auditors plus verifier/synthesis logic, retried stalled agents, and hit the 2399-second process timeout with the workflow killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed the process budget, but the time was spent in a single local implementation and verification loop with workflows disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel has a concrete concurrency-related closure loss from broad audit fan-out; serial has ordinary late local work but no child fan-out or trapped aggregate workflow result.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: both current completed status evaluations passed 10 of 10 tests. The substantive difference is trajectory strategy. Parallel reached a passing upstream-based artifact, then incurred a parallel coordination cost by launching a broad audit workflow that never synthesized before timeout. Serial reached a passing custom implementation through local iterative edits and tests without delegation.
parallel_contributors: Copied and installed an upstream-compatible implementation before launching the audit workflow.
Post-pass workflow fan-out consumed closure time and ended killed with no aggregate synthesis.
serial_contributors: Implemented the project directly and iteratively fixed tests and edge cases in one trajectory.
Kept verification local, so there was no child-result aggregation boundary.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel relied on upstream repository and sdist copying; serial wrote and refined its own implementation and tests.
Both processes timed out and final.txt files are empty, but official artifact evaluation still passed both.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel adverse process consequence only

candidates.near_match_reason: Verifier results were downstream of the fan-out and stall-retry budget exhaustion; the direct correction is to bound or avoid the broad audit workflow.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel parent launched a four-auditor workflow with verifier and synthesis phases after local success; repeated stalled-child retries consumed remaining budget and the aggregate result never returned before timeout.

cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: The retained fan-out episode is not split into child cancellation, retry, missing return, or blind wait labels because those share the same evidence chain and consequence.
